withdrawal.downloadIntro: Download the official semester/college withdrawal form, sign it, then upload it below.
withdrawal.advisorStep: After upload your academic advisor will review and add feedback.
withdrawal.financeStep: Finance approval — applies to self-funded students.
withdrawal.pucStep: PUC students must also submit نموذج تجميد البعثة + نموذج إيقاف القيد. Registration will help coordinate.
withdrawal.pucCollegeStep: PUC students must submit نموذج إلغاء بعثة signed by the student and guardian.
withdrawal.uploadProofPuc: Upload PUC proof of reason for withdrawal
withdrawal.feeFootnote: Fines are charged against total tuition. Withdrawing in week 5 or later forfeits the full term tuition.

absence.approvedNotice: Approved excuses are auto-applied to the course in the SIS.
absence.rejectedNotice: Rejected excuses include the rejection reason in the email.
absence.windowBody: Excuses must be submitted to Student Administrative Affairs within 5 working days of the absence date. Submissions outside this window are rejected automatically.
absence.stampNotice: Medical certificates must carry the stamp of the doctor and the hospital, clinic, or dispensary - public or private.

social.categoryHelp: We'll show the document checklist that matches your category.

transferCredit.intro: Submit prior college coursework to be evaluated against the CCK catalog. Results are returned by the Academic Department.

rules.contentEquivalence: Credit is transferred when the prior course is at least {{pct}}% equivalent in content to a CCK course.
rules.maxAgeYears: Transferable courses must have been taken in the last {{years}} years (exceptions: VP for Academic Affairs).
rules.minCgpa: Transfer applicants must have a minimum cumulative GPA of {{cgpa}} to apply.
rules.minCckCredits: Students must complete at least {{n}} credit hours at CCK to fulfill program requirements.
rules.recordAsCR: Approved credits are recorded on the transcript as '{{code}}' and are GPA-neutral.
rules.paaetCategoryOne: PAAET graduates with CGPA ≥ {{cgpa}}: at least {{minTransferable}} credits transferable (min. grade {{minGrade}}). Caps: {{business}} cr (Business) / {{advTech}} cr (Advanced Technology).
rules.paaetCategoryTwo: PAAET with GPA < 2.67 or non-graduates: up to {{business}} cr (Business) / {{advTech}} cr (Advanced Technology) — 50% of diploma requirements.
